Ana: Heads-up — on a Qwen-MQA heavy workload hitting long contexts (>=512k tokens) we see steady GPU memory growth over hours even at flat QPS. suspect kv-cache churn/paging rather than batch growth.
Suraj: Any allocator counters or evict logs? sounds like fragmentation or repeated small page allocs.
Ana: Pasted the allocator tail from last run: `kv_page_allocs=124823, kv_pages_in_use=8934, kv_evictions=4121, kv_reuse_hits=98` — reuse hits suspiciously low given repeated prefixes.
Marta: Interesting — Qwen's rotary/rope handling differs subtly from Llama. if our rope-rescale path isn't run for the MQA packing variant we can end up with mismatched KV slot canonicalization and missed reuse. that causes new pages to be allocated then later evicted.
Ana: Reproducer command I used: `./bin/run_long_context_test --model qwen-mqa-3b --tokens 524288 --batch 1 --seed 42`
Suraj: Can you drop the small profiler snippet? especially `% samples` for runtime hotspots.
Ana: Profiler snapshot (top lines):
```
42.1%  kv_page_alloc
27.4%  kv_eviction_scan
11.0%  kernel_select
6.8%   batching_scheduler_wait
3.7%   memcpy_kv
```
Marta: That aligns with my theory — lots of alloc/evict work. quick test: enabling `config.kv_compact_coalesce=true` reduced growth in a local run but introduced 40ms latency spikes on the hot path.
Suraj: Hmm — we need a fix that preserves reuse without expensive coalesces. possible approaches: 1) normalize rope offsets on insert so equivalent prefixes map to same slot, 2) change packing canonicalization for MQA to match non-MQA layout, 3) compact background sweeper that coalesces lazily.
Ana: I also noticed kernel_select is non-trivial here — maybe kernel selection is switching to a fallback kernel more often under fragmentation which causes extra allocations. attaching the kernel decision trace next run.
kv-bot: Created ticket RINF-3421: "kv-cache: qwen-mqa long-context allocation growth" with labels: eng-runtime, perf, blocker
Marta: I'll take the lead on the bisect. plan: run a minimal reproducer across commits that touched rope-rescale, kv-insert, and packing logic. @Suraj can you add perf uprobe hooks for kv_insert and kv_lookup?
Suraj: Yep — will drop the hooks and a flamegraph runner into the ticket today.
Ana: I'll run the overnight batch and attach logs + perf data to RINF-3421 tomorrow morning. thanks :thumbsup:
Marta: If anyone sees a quick mitigation we can flip at runtime, propose it in the ticket so SRE can toggle on staging first.
Ana: ack.
